meta.purpose: Group courses that train an actor's stage combat, accents and on-camera work, by town
meta.method: WebSearch (standard and extended) found providers; each course was then read from the provider's own page (readMethod 'page') with WebFetch, or with curl and a tag stripper where the WebFetch summariser could drop or scramble figures (raw HTML checked for Antaeus, HB Studio, Rapier Wit, Affair of Honour, EVN, Railtown, Shoreline, Armstrong, the Lir, Gaiety, City Academy, Vancouver Acting School, Stella Adler and the New Actors Centre). Policy PDFs (the Lir's terms, Gaiety's refund policy) were read with pypdf, City Lit's refund policy through its help-centre API (City Lit course pages return 403 to curl and were read through WebFetch), and St Tiernan's autumn calendar from its docx. Three entries were read on CourseHorse booking listings, a third-party platform, because no provider page was found or readable (NYC Stage & Screen Combat, Barrow Group Dialects, Los Angeles City College); each says so in notes. One entry (ID Fight, London) is a 'search-summary' read because its Jumbula booking pages sit behind a Cloudflare 403, which I did not bypass; its price is null. CasAzul's pages return only their menu unless the URL ends in a slash. Weekday uses 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday and every startDate was checked against its weekday in code. startDate is the start of the next section whose dates are published; where only a section already running is published it is that section's start and notes say 'under way at dateRead'; it is null where the provider prints no usable date (St Tiernan's, Actors Gym). 'sessions' is a printed count unless notes say 'derived' or 'my count' (Rapier Wit, Stella Adler Academy, ID Fight, EVN; Affair of Honour and Armstrong are counted from their printed day ranges). taxIncluded is true or false only where the page says so (true: Rapier Wit 'incl. HST'; false: ID Fight 'Prices are displayed ex VAT', Armstrong '+HST', EVN '+ HST', Shoreline '+ GST'), otherwise null. Prices are the full course price in the provider's currency; the one derived total (Vancouver Acting School, 3 x 249.99) is flagged in its notes. Where several sections run I recorded one and named the others in notes. Where a course carries a membership, prerequisite or application (New Actors Centre, Stella Adler, HB Accent Acquisition, Stella Adler Academy Speech III) the level field and notes say so. Several venues are in neighbouring municipalities (Antaeus: Glendale; Actors Gym: Hamden) and are labelled. The Actors Centre in London, named in the brief, has closed per the Marylebone Theatre's 12 Jan 2026 news page; its replacement is the New Actors Centre. Limits: the WebSearch tool reached its 200-call session budget before the Mexico City, New Haven, Toronto/Dublin accents and second-provider gaps could be searched, so those cells were covered by direct fetches of known provider sites only; towns and disciplines with no qualifying course are listed in notFound, and several cells have one provider rather than two.

The page covers scene study, text analysis, camera technique, audition etiquette and slating. The studio's 'Audition on Camera' (Mondays 6:30-9:30 pm, 19 Oct-9 Nov, 4 weeks, $270 + GST, David Kaye) is a second on-camera course. No refund terms on the pages.

courses.course: Taller: La cámara está encendida (Educación Continua)
courses.address: Blvd. Adolfo López Mateos 2625, Col. San Ángel Inn, Alcaldía Álvaro Obregón, CP 01790, Ciudad de México
courses.level: No prior acting experience needed ('No necesitas experiencia actoral previa'); ages 18 and older
courses.notes: Page: '18 y 25 de noviembre 2026 / 2 y 9 de diciembre de 2026', 'Miércoles de 16:00 a 20:00 hrs', '4 sesiones · 16 horas · Presencial', taught by Paty Soto (a CasAzul graduate); students work in front of the camera from the first day through play, improvisation and short scenes. 'PRECIO REGULAR $5,900 MXN' (recorded) and 'PRECIO DE LANZAMIENTO: $5,500 MXN'; the school's payment page shows $5,744.00 against $5,900.00; the full cost 'deberá ser cubierto antes del 13 de noviembre del 2026' (registration deadline). The page does not state IVA or any refund rule. The workshop page names no venue; the address is from CasAzul's 'nuevo campus' page (campus in use from the July 2026 school cycle), which another CasAzul workshop page also gives as its location. The page text only loads with the trailing-slash URL. CasAzul's 'Diplomado Actuación Frente a la Cámara' (Saturdays 10:00-15:00, 29 Aug-5 Dec 2026, for actors with professional experience; $2,100 MXN enrolment plus four payments of $3,350) was closed to new applicants (deadline 31 Jul) and is not recorded.

notFound.searched: WebSearch 'stage combat classes New Haven Connecticut adults course' and a wider 'New Haven CT acting classes adults stage combat OR fight choreography OR fencing' query returned only out-of-town hits (UNCSA summer programme, HB Studio in Manhattan, and, per a search summary, Phoenix Stage Company in Naugatuck, whose one-weekend stage-combat workshop was an earlier year's listing). Fetched Yale Repertory Theatre, Long Wharf Theatre (community programmes are pre-show talks and play clubs), the Shubert Theatre (education navigation shows Classroom Connections and Community Connections; the page itself was unreadable), Elm Shakespeare Company (youth programmes only), CT State's front page and Actors Gym in Hamden (its class buttons are acting, film/TV, commercial, improv, voice-over and the like; no combat class). No adult stage-combat course with a fixed schedule is published. Yale's drama school trains enrolled degree students only. The WebSearch budget ran out, so private fight directors and fencing clubs could not be searched.

CDMX', 'curso combate escénico OR esgrima escénica CDMX 2026 ...') returned a Hermosillo workshop (not CDMX), Spanish and Colombian listings, and a UNAM thesis that mentions an Escuela Mexicana de Combate Escénico, but no CDMX course page with a day, time and price. Read CasAzul's sitemap and course pages (diplomados and talleres in acting and camera work; no combat course), Foro Shakespeare's front page (calendar and calls only) and the Centro de Capacitación Cinematográfica's extension list (documentary and film-appreciation courses only). Guessed domains for EMCE did not resolve. The WebSearch budget then ran out, so no further CDMX providers could be searched.

No accents or dialect course for adult actors found. Yale's drama school teaches degree students only; Long Wharf, Yale Rep, the Shubert and Elm Shakespeare list no adult dialect classes (Elm's education is youth-only); Actors Gym in Hamden lists no accents class. No New Haven-specific accents query could be run before the WebSearch budget ran out.

Searched Dublin accent and dialect courses (Lir Academy, Gaiety School of Acting, Bow Street Academy, Irish Equity) and read the providers' pages. The Lir's 'Accents Workshops' are one-day intensives with no fixed dates and its own course page returns 404; Gaiety's 'One to One Accent Class' is a private one-hour class (EUR 85), its 'Accent Masterclass for Auditions' is a one-day workshop from a 2016 article; Bow Street's part-time list shows screen-acting courses only; Irish Equity's accent and dialect workshop (EUR 130, two 2-day groups) was a past August block for members by application. None is a multi-session group course with a fixed weekly day now on sale.

Searched Toronto accents and dialect classes. Second City's 'Intro to Dialects' is online only; Comedy Bar's 'Intro to Dialects' (Matthew Romantini, Comedy Bar Danforth, 2800 Danforth Avenue, $100 + tax) was a single Saturday (9 Aug) workshop; Armstrong Acting Studios, EVN Studios and John Boylan's Centre for the Arts list on-camera, scene and audition classes but no accents class; the college searches (George Brown, Humber, TMU) returned only full-time diploma programmes, and Eventbrite's Toronto pages returned unrelated events. No multi-session in-person accents course found. The WebSearch budget ran out before a Toronto dialect-coach search could be run.

Searched 'acentos y dialectos para actores' and 'acento neutro' with CasAzul, CEFAC and Foro Shakespeare: no CDMX accents course found. CasAzul's sitemap and pages show diplomados and talleres in acting and camera work but no accents course; CEFAC's domain redirected to an unrelated site and was not followed; the Centro de Capacitación Cinematográfica's extension list has no acting course. The WebSearch budget ran out before further Spanish-language queries.
